{{Quote|Glorzo proposed a contest. The scavenger and I would head into the Vaal asteroid field&mdash;hopefully surviving more than two minutes. The first to bring back a stone from the Rukabi Major asteroid would win dear Holiday.|[[Tharan Cedrax]]|<ref name="The Old Republic" />}}
The '''Vaal asteroid field'''<ref name="The Old Republic" /> consisted of several [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid fields]] located in the [[Vaal system/Legends|Vaal system]], intersecting the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaal/Legends|Vaal's]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]] sustained damaged upon entering the Vaal asteroid field, causing it to crash-land on Vaal.<ref name="The Savage Heart" />
